title: How Long Do You Have Left To Live?
summary: Your routine, sleep, stress and everyday choices feed a prediction that may be more revealing than you expect.

landing.intro: Tell AI how you really live and it’ll calculate how long you have left.

about.body:
This five-round quiz uses familiar lifestyle clues—including routine, food, movement, sleep, stress, social connection, daily choices and recovery—to create a playful years-left estimate and personality-style result. Its 40 interactions are deliberately varied, so it feels more like an unfolding AI lifestyle scan than a health questionnaire.

Each round explores a different part of everyday life, then reveals how far the prediction journey has progressed. The final prediction choice provides only a restrained calibration, so it cannot determine the displayed estimate on its own.

The quiz does not use medical records, clinical research, family history, current age, healthcare data or an individual risk assessment. The displayed estimate is a playful quiz mechanic based only on the choices made during this attempt.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Choose the lifestyle answer that feels most like you without overthinking it.
Complete each eight-question round to reveal the next part of your prediction journey.
Finish the final calibration to reveal your playful AI estimate and profile.

about.disclaimer: This quiz is for fun and self-reflection only. It does not predict your lifespan, health, future, mortality risk or medical outcomes. If you have health concerns, speak to a qualified healthcare professional.

centenarian_energy.title: Centenarian Energy
centenarian_energy.copy: Your answers give off steady-habit energy: small joys, a bit of movement, and a surprising talent for choosing the sensible option without making life boring. You make consistency feel natural rather than strict.

steady_long_game.title: The Steady Long Game
steady_long_game.copy: Your answers point to a slow-burn lifestyle: practical choices, decent pacing, and the kind of everyday consistency that makes your future self quietly grateful. You tend to choose progress you can actually sustain.

balanced_realist.title: The Balanced Realist
balanced_realist.copy: Your answers suggest a grounded mix of sense and fun. You know life is not a wellness brochure, but you also know when a small choice keeps things smoother.

weekend_chaos.title: Weekend Chaos Mode
weekend_chaos.copy: Your answers have bright, chaotic, “this became a story” energy. You may not always choose the tidy path, but you bring spark, humor, and momentum.

stress_sprinter.title: The Stress Sprinter
stress_sprinter.copy: Your answers point to deadline-fuelled energy: fast, capable, and occasionally powered by pure suspense. Your best upgrade is pacing, not panic.

comfort_creature.title: The Comfort Creature
comfort_creature.copy: Your answers lean familiar, low-drama, and comfort-loving. You know the value of ease, and your sweet spot is soft living with just enough fresh air.

adventure_fuse.title: Adventure Fuse
adventure_fuse.copy: Your answers have restless, curious, say-yes energy. You are drawn to novelty, stories, movement, and the feeling that a normal day could still become memorable.

reset_needed.title: Reset Needed
reset_needed.copy: Your answers suggest your system is asking for a reset: fewer tiny fires, more breathing room, and a rhythm that lets you feel like a person again. Very fixable. Very relatable.

reviewUnlock.title: Unlock what shaped your result
reviewUnlock.copy: See each choice you made and whether it raised, lowered or kept your estimate neutral.
